question:
The given bar graph shows the data of the production of cookies (in thousand packs) by three branches B1, B2 and B3 of company A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/917f23ba31506c96c367644849037091d17d85e61c11f31cdba70831dd1e4a19.png] 

What is the ratio of the average production by branch B2 in the year 3 and year 4 to the average production of branch B1 in the same period?
solution:
**Given:**

Production by branch B2 in year 3 = 45 thousand

Production by branch B2 in year 4 = 45 thousand

Production by branch B1 in year 3 = 35 thousand

Production by branch B1 in year 4 = 55 thousand

**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of quantities) ÷ (Number of years)

Ratio = Average production by B2 ÷ Average production by B1

**Calculation:**

Average production by B2 in year 3 and 4:

⇒ (45 + 45) ÷ 2

⇒ 90 ÷ 2 = 45

Average production by B1 in year 3 and 4:

⇒ (35 + 55) ÷ 2

⇒ 90 ÷ 2 = 45

Ratio:

⇒ 45 ÷ 45

⇒ 1:1

**∴ The ratio is 1:1.**
